subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Eric learned that maps are not only tools for travel.”?
options: It makes knowledge more powerful when used carefully.
They are pictures of time, knowledge, and change.
Changing the time can change the feeling of a place.
"You try, fail, change something, and try again."

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It makes knowledge more powerful when used carefully.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Eric learned that maps are not only tools for travel. They are pictures of time, knowledge, and change.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Changing the time can change the feeling of a place.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「'You try, fail, change something, and try again.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Eric learned that maps are not only tools for travel. They are pictures of time, knowledge, and change.」，答案為「They are pictures of time, knowledge, and change.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「They are pictures of time, knowledge, and change.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
